author: KEXP
description: The sensational Texas trio @Khruangbin share their signature, otherworldly groove in our latest in-studio session. With a live performance of “White Gloves ii" and more from ’The Universe Smiles Upon You ii,’ the band create an exhilarating and soothing sonic atmosphere coated in psych, dub, funk, and surf.
title: Khruangbin performs "White Gloves ii" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Khruangbin performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded November 19, 2025.

Songs:
Two Fish and an Elephant ii
August Twelve ii
Balls and Pins ii
White Gloves ii

Laura Lee - Bass, Vocals
Mark Speer - Guitar, Vocals
Donald “DJ” Johnson - Drums, Vocals
Will Van Horn - Guitar, Percussion, Keys

Host: Cheryl Waters
Audio Engineer: Kevin Suggs
Guest Audio Engineer: Jade Payne
Audio Mixer: Steve Christensen
Mastering Engineer: Julian Martlew

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Scott Holpainen & Luke Knecht
Editor: Jim Beckmann
